scripts.build: rm -rf .next && NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") next build
scripts.pages:build: rm -rf .next .vercel && NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static
scripts.preview: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages dev .vercel/output/static
